decks.notes: The main idea of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to utilize cheap, efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Ninja of the Deep Hours to put early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Counterspell. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Ponder and Preordain to help ensure consistent draws and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, using evasion and counterspells to control the board and win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap artifact creatures and sacrificing artifacts to deal damage to the opponent. With cards like Atog and Disciple of the Vault, the goal is to quickly build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with damage. Cards like Galvanic Blast and Fling provide additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes various artifacts like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring to help with card advantage and mana fixing. It is a fast-paced, aggressive deck that aims to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on using the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana in order to control the game through card advantage and disruption. It utilizes cards like Mnemonic Wall and Mulldrifter for card advantage, while also including tools like Stonehorn Dignitary and Moment's Peace to stall the opponent. The deck also includes various counterspells and removal spells to deal with threats, as well as ways to search for specific cards like Mystical Teachings and Crop Rotation. Additionally, the deck includes ways to gain life and draw cards to help survive in longer games.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Seeker of the Way and Boros Garrison, the deck aims to put consistent pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Journey to Nowhere and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes cards like Faithless Looting and Squadron Hawk to help maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, this deck is designed to quickly build a threatening board presence and control the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm opponents with a fast, aggressive playstyle using low mana cost creatures and spells like Seeker of the Way, Squadron Hawk, and Battle Screech. The deck also includes removal spells like Journey to Nowhere and Dust to Dust to control the board. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Prismatic Strands and Rally the Peasants to protect your creatures and boost their attacking power. The deck aims to maintain board presence and apply pressure on the opponent to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a wide board presence of low-cost creatures, utilizing the card draw and token generation provided by cards like Squadron Hawk and Battle Screech. By efficiently using resources like Faithless Looting and Thrilling Discovery, as well as protection spells like Prismatic Strands, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures and then finish them off with a powerful mass pump effect like Rally the Peasants. The mana base allows for consistent casting of spells while also providing some card advantage with Ash Barrens.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage while utilizing the flicker effect of Ephemerate to gain value from enters-the-battlefield effects multiple times. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, card draw, and creatures with strong enters-the-battlefield abilities to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the game. The mana base includes a variety of dual lands to ensure consistent mana production for the deck's spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells and removal, while disrupting their board with creatures like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours. The deck also utilizes faeries and card draw spells to maintain hand advantage and pressure the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Skred and Lightning Bolt provides removal and direct damage, making it a versatile deck able to adapt to different matchups. The mana base is optimized for consistency and access to all required colors.

The deck is focused on quickly deploying small creatures and using them to disrupt the opponent's plans while dealing damage. By utilizing cheap and efficient spells, the deck aims to control the game's tempo and protect its creatures. The inclusion of Ninjas allows for extra card advantage and unblockable damage, while Mutagenic Growth provides unexpected combat tricks. The deck's consistency is enhanced by card draw and manipulation spells, ensuring that it can maintain pressure and outpace the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the powerful interaction between Ephemerate and creatures with strong enters-the-battlefield effects. By constantly blinking key creatures like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer, the deck aims to generate card advantage and control the board while gaining incremental value each turn. The deck also includes various card draw and filtering spells to ensure consistency, along with counterspells and bounce effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is built to support these strategies and ensure smooth gameplay.

The focus of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's plays and control the board through efficient removal spells and versatile creatures. By combining countermagic with removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down, as well as card advantage engines like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Augur of Bolas, the deck aims to control the game tempo and out-value the opponent. The deck also utilizes Faerie Seer and Spellstutter Sprite for early board presence and disruption, while finishing off the game with evasive threats like Gurmag Angler.

The key strategy of this deck is to control the game by efficiently using cards that draw or recur other cards, while also generating substantial mana with the Urzatron lands. This control deck aims to outlast opponents by countering threats, drawing cards, and recurring key spells like Moment's Peace to buy time until it can establish a dominant board presence. The inclusion of various forms of card advantage and versatility allows the deck to adapt to different matchups and ultimately overwhelm opponents with powerful late-game plays.

This Pauper 1 vs 1 Control deck focuses on using Ephemerate to blink creatures like Archaeomancer and Mulldrifter for repeated value while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Counterspells and removal spells like Abrade and Fiery Cannonade. The deck also includes card draw and deck manipulation with Preordain and Thoughtcast, as well as land destruction with Cleansing Wildfire. The goal is to control the board and outvalue the opponent with efficient creatures and powerful spell interactions.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy creatures like Seeker of the Way and Squadron Hawk to apply pressure on the opponent, while controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere. The deck also utilizes tokens from Battle Screech and Rally the Peasants to close out games. Additionally, it includes card advantage engines like Thraben Inspector and Palace Sentinels to maintain a steady stream of threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle while maintaining card advantage and control over the battlefield.

Utilizing cards that provide card advantage, disruption, and removal, this deck aims to control the game's tempo and outvalue opponent's resources. By using cheap counterspells, removal spells, and creatures with ETB effects, it can answer threats efficiently while maintaining card advantage through draw spells and cantrip creatures. The deck also includes evasive creatures to push through damage and pressure opponents while disrupting their game plan. Overall, the strategy is to stay ahead on board presence and resources until the opponent runs out of answers.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with efficient creatures like Seeker of the Way and Squadron Hawk, while also providing card advantage with cards like Faithless Looting and Battle Screech. The deck aims to maintain control of the battlefield with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere, while also utilizing combat tricks like Prismatic Strands and Rally the Peasants to push through damage and close out the game quickly. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and to support its aggressive game plan.
